g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Amazon ECS on Fargate API with Aurora, ElastiCache and an SQS worker

g.title: None.None.Node.35
g.text: The client resolves api.example.com in Route 53
and reaches the Application Load Balancer, where AWS WAF filters the request
The load balancer sends it to an API task on Fargate in a private subnet
and reads or writes the order in Aurora PostgreSQL
Slow work, such as a confirmation email, goes on SQS through the interface endpoint
A worker task polls the queue; messages that fail five times move to the dead-letter queue
and calls the email provider through the NAT gateway
which leaves through the internet gateway
